_comment: AWS's P-EAGLE drafters (arXiv 2602.01469): EAGLE-3 trained to draft every token of a step in one forward, its rows past the newest reading learned placeholders (the `ptd_token_id` token's embedding and `mask_hidden`, which vLLM's `parallel_drafting` loads the same way). It ships as its own checkpoint with its own config, whose `architectures` reads `LlamaForCausalLM`, so it names its target config (`head_targets`) and the repo its target drafts with by default (`published_as`). Its tensors sit at the file's top level (`decoder_safetensors_prefix` empty): its first layer as `midlayer.*`, the rest as `layers.<L>.*`. It borrows only its target's lm_head (`borrows`): AWS froze it in training, so the drafter's own copy is the target's bit for bit; its embedding it trained, so that one is its own. It drafts over its target vocabulary's first 65536 ids (`vocab_size`, the lm_head rows it reads), as Qwen3.5's head does; its embedding keeps every id (`embed_vocab_size`), the mask token's (201020) among them. `target_hidden_size` is the width of the three target hidden states `fc` fuses.
